summary: Hubbell Inc filed an 8-K (Items 1.01, 2.03) regarding entry into a Term Loan Agreement to finance its pending acquisition of NSI Electrical Buyer, Inc. (the NSI Acquisition). Under the agreement disclosed on May 1, 2026, Hubbell will purchase all outstanding capital stock of the Company. The Term Loan provides up to $900 million unsecured, available in a single borrowing at closing, with interest based on Alternate Base Rate or Term SOFR plus a credit-rating-based spread. The loan matures three years from closing and includes a financial covenant limiting total indebtedness to total capitalization to no more than 65%. Regulatory and other customary closing conditions remain. Watch for the acquisition close timeline and NSF's existing debt repayment.
